name: Gyroscope
author: Trance
description: Six rings turning inside one another in three dimensions. Each tumbles faster the louder its range, from the great outer ring on the rumble to the smallest on the cymbals.
init:
a0 = rand(6)
b0 = rand(6)
a1 = rand(6)
b1 = rand(6)
a2 = rand(6)
b2 = rand(6)
a3 = rand(6)
b3 = rand(6)
a4 = rand(6)
b4 = rand(6)
a5 = rand(6)
b5 = rand(6)

layers.point:
th = t*tau
px = 0.85*cos(th)
py = 0.85*sin(th)
qy = py*cos(a0)
qz = py*sin(a0)
rx = px*cos(b0) + qz*sin(b0)
rz = qz*cos(b0) - px*sin(b0)
ps = 2.2/(2.2 + rz)
x = rx*ps
y = qy*ps
a = a*clamp(0.25 + 0.6*(ps - 0.7), 0.2, 1)
